company.name: Supercell
company.shortDescription: Supercell is a video game development company for tablets and smart phones.
company.description:
Supercell reimagines games with a Tablet First strategy. Supercell's goal is to build an environment where small, independent teams can craft games for as many people as possible, that are played for years and remembered forever.

The company is best known for its successful video games like Clash Royale, Boom Beach, Clash of Clans, and Hay Day.

Based in Helsinki, Finland, with North American operations in San Francisco, Supercell was formed by games industry veterans who have collectively developed more than 165 games across 12 platforms.  Supercell is backed by Accel Partners and London Venture Partners (LVP).

aiResearchSummary.text: Supercell is developing methods and systems that enhance online and mobile gaming on smartphones and tablets. Work described in titles such as “Online game management device, method and system,” “Computer program and device for controlling game play,” and “Method for facilitating user interactions in gaming environment,” along with related abstracts, focuses on multiplayer session management, responsive graphical user interfaces, improved touch interactions, movement control, and secure, fraud‑resistant game execution. Together these efforts target gameplay control, UI interaction, security, and session management.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $130,000,000, or 90.89% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $52,300,000 to $770,000,000, a 14.72x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 52 (-14 over 90 days) and market heat at 36 (+3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
